integrity: Explicit complementary-subalgebra proof and direct prime-field subspace, operator and automorphism enumeration are supplied; external independent audit remains unperformed.
limitations: Only idempotent weight-minus-one operators are classified. No claim is made that all positive-characteristic Rota–Baxter operators split. General-field classification uses a structural proof; finite checks are only over three prime fields. Historical coverage is not certified complete.
title: Rank and orbit census for splitting projections on the plane exterior algebra
